blocking_and_framing.observed_evidence: The card rapidly fills the foreground and converts a subtle side insert into a hero-prop presentation.
blocking_and_framing.recommended_repair_action: Lock the side angle and keep the card under eight percent of the frame; never move it toward camera.

gaze_and_eyeline.observed_evidence: The nurse becomes near-frontal and the background patient does not clearly glance toward his pocket.
gaze_and_eyeline.recommended_repair_action: Keep the nurse in profile and show one small patient glance from card to jacket pocket.

wardrobe_construction.observed_evidence: The nurse changes to a blue uniform without the established teal scrubs and open grey cardigan.

prop_identity_ownership.observed_evidence: The card grows from ordinary proportions into an oversized foreground rectangle.
prop_identity_ownership.recommended_repair_action: Keep ordinary plastic-card dimensions and consistent blue-white colour.

prop_interaction.observed_evidence: The handoff turns into holding the card outward rather than returning it naturally across the counter.
prop_interaction.recommended_repair_action: Start at the counter handoff plane and complete one lateral return to the departing adult.

performance_action_match.observed_evidence: The card moment is underlined and the patient's wallet/pocket recognition is absent.

continuity.observed_evidence: Nurse wardrobe and prop scale do not match the accepted master/prop plan.

symbolic_environment.observed_evidence: The oversized card becomes explanatory imagery instead of quiet environmental foreshadowing.
